stages.dispatch: Just as we suspected, the gem smuggler hired the G-Kings to steal jewelry for him. <Col: StageText>Prevent them</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering the stolen goods</Col>.

stages.owner: The bling king wants your head on the block. You picked up a fake necklace instead of a real one. I know of another jeweler - <Col: StageText>burgle his store room</Col> and get the real deal this time.
stages.dispatch: The G-Kings are either brave or stupid: they are going back out for another necklace. Someone must have a big neck! <Col: StageText>Stop the Gs </Col>from <Col: StageText>burglarizing this store room</Col>.

stages.owner: The guy has gotta like that piece, it's from the best jeweler in town. <Col: StageText>Bring the necklace </Col>back here, and we'll get his majesty to empty his coffers.
stages.dispatch: We can't let the G-Kings escape with such a valuable item. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering the necklace</Col>, or we'll lose profitable security contracts.

stages.owner: Capture and hold our drop-off location and kill any Enforcers who try to get near it.
stages.dispatch: <Col: StageText>Capture and hold </Col>the drop-off location the G-Kings are heading to, and kill any of them who try to get near it. Any friend of the Gs is a target of ours!

stages.owner: Some of Jeung's crew were caught on camera during a shootout at the Kestrel Club. If we pay the head doorman, he'll make the images disappear. <Col: StageText>Break into these cars </Col>and steal enough to bribe him.
stages.dispatch: Our stakeout reports that the Blood Roses just left large amounts of cash in two vehicles. It's to pay off the doorman at the Kestrel Club, the location of last night's shoot out. <Col: StageText>Stop anyone </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the cash</Col>.

stages.owner: The Kestrel’s doorman wants <Col: StageText>the money delivered here </Col>before he tells us where the video files are. I guess he doesn't earn enough taking bribes from 16-year-olds trying to get in the club...
stages.dispatch: The Blood Roses are moving large amounts of money around. It will be to bribe any witnesses to last night's shootings at the Kestrel Club. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the bribes</Col>.

stages.owner: The doorman left the video files for us on a USB stick. <Col: StageText>Acquire it</Col>, so we can make sure it's never seen again. We'll have a peek first; Jeung's boasting about how many shots he fired.
stages.dispatch: The Blood Roses have just delivered a large amount of cash to the doorman of the Kestrel Club. He sold them tape of last night's shootings. <Col: StageText>Prevent the Roses </Col>from <Col: StageText>retrieving the security files</Col>.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Take the memory stick </Col>with those video files back to the Blood Rose hideout and we can erase it. <Col: StageText>Don’t get caught, </Col>or the Enforcers'll have a field day with that evidence.
stages.dispatch: If the Blood Roses paid so much for the Kestrel Club video file, it must be full of evidence. They're trying to take it back to their hideout to wipe it. <Col: StageText>Stop them.</Col>

stages.owner: The security guard screwed us! That wasn't the tape. Luckily, we suspected this and had a tail on him after he grabbed the cash. He stashed the tape around here. <Col: StageText>Find and hold onto that tape.</Col>
stages.dispatch: The security guard screwed them. That wasn't the tape. We expected this and had guys tail him after he grabbed the cash, he actually stashed the tape here. Find and hold onto that tape.

stages.owner: Scandal-tastic. Sofia from the Tigers has been caught on camera 'licking the love lollipop'. We gotta buy the master copy before her publicist can. <Col: StageText>Break into these cars </Col>where we hide emergency cash.
stages.dispatch: The G-Kings move cash around by car in this area. Two cars near you now are parked suspiciously. The Gs must be up to something. <Col: StageText>Stop anyone </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the cash</Col>.

stages.owner: The owner of the salacious video is the security guard from Sofia's building. He gave us a rendezvous point where we can <Col: StageText>drop off the money</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The G-Kings are trying to buy a video supposedly showing Sofia in a compromising situation. <Col: StageText>Stop the Gs </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the cash </Col>and buying the master tape.

stages.owner: The security guard received his payment and has given us the location of the Sofiagate video. <Col: StageText>Pick up the video </Col>before anyone blurs out all the good parts.
stages.dispatch: Even if the Sofia sex tape is a fake, it could damage the whole Enforcer community if the G-Kings release it. <Col: StageText>Prevent them </Col>from <Col: StageText>collecting the tape </Col>at all costs.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Deliver the video </Col>to the G-King tech guys. <Col: StageText>Don’t get caught </Col>though - we all want to see that video before we upload it!
stages.dispatch: The G-Kings have the libelous video of Sofia and are taking it to be digitized and uploaded. <Col: StageText>Stop them.</Col>

stages.owner: The security guard screwed us! That wasn't the tape. Luckily, we suspected this and had a tail on him after he grabbed the cash. He stashed the tape around here. <Col: StageText>Find and hold onto that tape.</Col>
stages.dispatch: The security guard screwed them. That wasn't the tape. We expected this and had guys tail him after he grabbed the cash, he actually stashed the tape here. Find and hold onto that tape.

stages.owner: Pagan is stuck at a restaurant with her family. Her uncle, Commissioner of the SPPD, is asking awkward questions. Do Pagan a favor and <Col: StageText>break in </Col>to where she keeps her Blood Rose cash and remove it.
stages.dispatch: We've figured out where Pagan Bloodrose keeps her ill-gotten gains. Roses are trying to clear the place out before we can get there. <Col: StageText>Stop them breaking in </Col>and taking the money.

stages.owner: Good work. Pagan wouldn't want all those hard-earned dollars falling into the right hands. <Col: StageText>Drop them off </Col>near the restaurant; she'll come out and pick them up later.
stages.dispatch: The Roses made off with Pagan Bloodrose's dirty money before we could get a warrant to search the stash house. <Col: StageText>Prevent them</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering it </Col>to her.

stages.owner: Pagan is getting grilled by her Uncle, Commissioner Carter. Create an emergency for him to have to deal with. <Col: StageText>Burn these businesses, </Col>but <Col: StageText>avoid getting killed</Col>: that'd only raise further questions.
stages.dispatch: Pagan Bloodrose knows we're onto her; she's looking to cause a major distraction as a decoy. <Col: StageText>Protect these buildings </Col>from being torched. <Col: StageText>Eliminate </Col>anyone who tries to stop you.

stages.owner: Those fires aren't cutting it. Get out there and make your presence known by <Col: StageText>controlling this area</Col>. Some Enforcer bloodshed will give Comissioner Carter something other'n Pagan to worry about.
stages.dispatch: Those fires aren't the Commissioner's problem but Criminals openly causing havoc would be cause for concern. Keep them out of this area before people start panicking.

stages.owner: Terri Quan is good friends with TV chef Rick Shank. A company has refused to pay their bill at Rick's restaurant. <Col: StageText>Break into their offices </Col>and <Col: StageText>take </Col>what they owe. And get a tip too.
stages.dispatch: The G-Kings have been called in to recover a debt for a local restaurant. <Col: StageText>Stop the G-Kings </Col>from <Col: StageText>breaking into the office </Col>of the alleged debtors.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Drop off the payment </Col>next to Rick's resturant. He'll come out and pick it up later, so we aren't connected. Any friend of Terri's...
stages.dispatch: The G-Kings have looted over $5000 and are delivering it the restaurant that hired them to steal it. <Col: StageText>Prevent the Gs </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the money</Col>.

stages.owner: To make sure no one is around to see Rick picking up the money, go create a G-King style ruckus. <Col: StageText>Burn these businesses, </Col>but <Col: StageText>avoid getting killed</Col>; Rick is a strict vegetarian.
stages.dispatch: To conceal where and when they will drop off the cash to the restaurant, the G-Kings're planning a distraction. <Col: StageText>Protect these buildings </Col>from being torched. <Col: StageText>Kill anyone </Col>who gets in the way.

stages.owner: Rick Shank's being kinda paranoid and wants more of a distraction than just a few housefires. Get out there and make your presence known by <Col: StageText>controlling this area.</Col>
stages.dispatch: Those fires aren't big enough for a distraction and looks like these Criminals are eager for a bigger distraction. Keep them out of this area before they incite mass panic.

stages.owner: An information broker called Pierre Dorval is selling us personal information on key Enforcer figures. <Col: StageText>Loot </Col>the first <Col: StageText>file </Col>from this <Col: StageText>vehicle </Col>and make sure you keep it safe.
stages.dispatch: An information broker called Pierre Dorval has sold family information belonging to various CSA operatives. <Col: StageText>Protect the vehicle</Col> that the items are hidden in, we'll send tech's round later to investigate.

stages.owner: Pierre isn't dumb: this being San Paro, and in case something happened to you, his information has been stashed at a few different drops. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the second set of <Col: StageText>files </Col>hidden nearby.
stages.dispatch: The information broker also sold details of Derren's schedule for public appearances - that's an assassination risk. <Col: StageText>Stop the Crims </Col>from <Col: StageText>retrieving that information</Col>.

stages.owner: Pierre Dorval is nicely thorough - but then the quality of his information always makes anyone carrying it a target. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the last set of <Col: StageText>files </Col>he dropped off. And watch your back!
stages.dispatch: The last information sold by the broker details potential security blackspots at Fourche Bank. We don't want them in our base, killing our dudes. <Col: StageText>Stop the Criminals </Col>from <Col: StageText>gathering that final piece of intel</Col>.

stages.owner: Files gathered. <Col: StageText>Deliver </Col>the <Col: StageText>information </Col>to the <Col: StageText>hideout</Col>. When we get this up on i-Net, everyone'll know just how corrupt the 'Forcers really are!
stages.dispatch: Taken together, that information poses a major security risk for the entire Enforcement faction. <Col: StageText>Stop the Criminals </Col>before they <Col: StageText>deliver the information </Col>to their <Col: StageText>hideout</Col>.

stages.owner: Aw, hell. The Enforcers figured out where Dorval's laptop is. If we can protect it we'll gain a powerful ally and hopefully a future discount! <Col: StageText>Protect </Col>this <Col: StageText>location</Col>.

Aw, hell. The Enforcers figured out where Dorval's laptop is. If we can protect it we'll gain a powerful ally and hopefully a future discount! <Col: StageText>Protect </Col>this <Col: StageText>location</Col>.
stages.dispatch: We need to shut down that chicken-shit Pierre Dorval - <Col: StageText>raid </Col>his <Col: StageText>address </Col>and see if you can find his <Col:StageText>laptop</Col>. He's been selling way too many Enforcement secrets. He's a danger to this city!

stages.owner: Those fucking 'Forcers have found Dorval's <Col:StageText>laptop</Col>. <Col:StageText>Retrieve it</Col> and return it to our new safehouse.
Those fucking 'Forcers have found Dorval's <Col:StageText>laptop</Col>. <Col:StageText>Retrieve it</Col> and return it to our new safehouse.
stages.dispatch: You've found his files; good job.  <Col:StageText> Recover the laptop</Col> and take it to our techs.

stages.owner: Wanna play doctors and nurses? A specialist job requires some specialist medical equipment. Before you get the gear, you're gonna need to <Col: StageText>sabotage </Col>this <Col: StageText>GPS transmitter</Col>.
stages.dispatch: We just intercepted a message that Criminals are planning on sabotaging a GPS receiver - it tracks every EMT vehicle for two miles around. <Col: StageText>Stop the Criminals </Col>from <Col: StageText>disabling </Col>the <Col: StageText>GPS device</Col>.

stages.owner: Good. The <Col: StageText>ambulance </Col>we need has a tracking device which is now offline. We've remotely overridden the locks so go <Col: StageText>pick it up </Col>and I’ll send you our next objective once it’s secured..
stages.dispatch: Gang members have disabled the transmitter that tracks emergency vehicles. Now they're trying to steal an <Col: StageText>ambulance </Col>specialized for organ transport. <Col: StageText>Stop the Criminals</Col>.

stages.owner: Hope you're not squeamish! You've gotta <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>some black market <Col: StageText>organs</Col>. It's probably best you don't ask where they came from, or who bought them. Just know we're being paid well for this.
stages.dispatch: The Criminals have stolen the ambulance and are heading to <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>some... black market organs, looks like? Gross. <Col: StageText>Stop the Criminals </Col>from making the pick-up.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Deliver the organs </Col>to "The Doctor's <Col: StageText>Office</Col>." Just leave them out the front of the place... Buyer wrote me an e-mail - Subj: 'It reminds me of chicken.' Still... The money's good.
stages.dispatch: The Criminals are transporting the stolen organs. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the organs </Col>to their buyer. Man, stealing people parts? This has to be a new all-time low, even for them.

stages.owner: Enforcers found out about more of our other, more legitimate, buyers and are going to raid their homes. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>these <Col: StageText>buildings </Col>.
stages.dispatch: I'm all for a free market economy, but selling corpse parts is really fucked up. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>these suspected <Col: StageText>organ farms </Col>and shut them down.
I'm all for a free market economy, but selling corpse parts is really fucked up. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>the suspected <Col: StageText>organ farm </Col>and shut them down.

stages.owner: Ok, now <Col:StageText>return those Organs</Col> back to base before the Enforcers can get them.
stages.dispatch: Ok, now <Col:StageText>return those Organs</Col> back to base before the Criminals can get them.

stages.owner: Ok, now <Col:StageText>return those Organs</Col> back to base before the Enforcers can get them.
stages.dispatch: Ok, now <Col:StageText>return those Organs</Col> back to base before the Criminals can get them.

stages.owner: We got cars burnin' through our turf night and day - turns out some street racers are doing a triathlon in different cars. Stop the Exec Express stage of the race. <Col: StageText>Shoot up </Col>their <Col: StageText>rides</Col>.
stages.dispatch: A gang has stolen several executive vehicles belonging to WP Media board members. <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>them from <Col: StageText>destroying </Col>the <Col: StageText>saloon cars</Col>, so we can return them to their rightful owners.

stages.owner: Good job shooting up those cars. To be sure those racers get the message, <Col: StageText>spray some graffiti </Col>up in their neighborhood. Make sure they know our turf ain't a race track.
stages.dispatch: Those thieving bastards are trying to leave anti-CSA graffiti in the area. <Col: StageText>Stop them tagging </Col>up these walls. We can't lose two cars AND have them putting up propaganda!

stages.owner: Those street racers say we ain't worth dick and they ain't gonna be intimidated. Bullshit! <Col: StageText>Torch these cars </Col>too. <Col: StageText>Avoid getting killed </Col>- no way to teach mofos respect if you're dead!
stages.dispatch: Ah, hell. The thieves have found out about cars owned by the chairman of WP Media - Brandon Hay. Odds are they're going to burn them. <Col: StageText>Stop the thieves </Col>from <Col: StageText>burning the cars</Col>.

stages.owner: We marked our turf and made a show of force. <Col: StageText>Defend the area</Col> for a while; some of those racers aren't gonna be happy about our presence.
stages.dispatch: This gang thinks it can just come in and tell us what we can and can't do in this hood. Keep them away from here by <Col: StageText>controlling the area</Col>.

stages.owner: Our target is a collector's home, and two vintage Colby 1864 box-lock rifles kept there: real Civil War shit, and heavily protected. To start with, <Col: StageText>burn this building </Col>to create a distraction.
stages.dispatch: The Hazuki and Zhao families have long been at war. Things have escalated with the death of a Hazuki clan member. <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>their hired henchmen from <Col: StageText>burning this office </Col>owned by the Zhao.

stages.owner: While that blaze is keeping people busy, <Col: StageText>bomb this electrical box </Col>powering the security systems and locks at the collector's home.
stages.dispatch: The Hazuki family still wants vengeance. They're bombing electrical junctions to knock out the security system of the Zhao family stronghold. <Col: StageText>Stop the bombing attack</Col>.

stages.owner: With the power down, you should be able to <Col: StageText>break into the house </Col>without every Enforcer in the city turning up at the doorstep.
stages.dispatch: With the security systems taken down by the bombing attack, the Zhao stronghold is open to attack. <Col: StageText>Stop the Hazuki </Col>from <Col: StageText>breaking in </Col>to the building.

stages.owner: Sounds like everyone was right: you're just the person I needed for this job. <Col: StageText>Deliver the antique guns </Col>to our drop-off and I'll make sure they find a nice new home.
stages.dispatch: The Hazuki stole the Zhao's family heirloom: an ancient mirror of pure silver. <Col: StageText>Stop the thieves </Col>before they <Col: StageText>deliver the mirror </Col>- this feud will get even worse if the Hazuki get away with it.

stages.owner: The buyer apparently anticipated your success - our payment is prepped and ready for transport. <Col: StageText>Pick up the cash</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The Hazuki have sold the ancient mirror. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the payment </Col>before the their henchmen do. We might be able to trace the buyer and stop all-out war between the Hazuki and the Zhao.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Deliver the cash </Col>back the hideout. Don't let the Enforcers get their hands on it. Excellent work.
stages.dispatch: <Col: StageText>Get the cash to our lockup </Col> - <Col: StageText>don't let the Hazuki deliver it to their drop-off</Col>. Without that money, we have no hope of retrieving the mirror and ending this feud.

<Col: StageText>Get the cash to our lockup </Col> - <Col: StageText>don't let the Hazuki deliver it to their drop-off</Col>. Without that money, we have no hope of retrieving the mirror and ending this feud.

stages.owner: Our crew are complaining about the state of the hideout. We need extra cash to 'bling it up a bit'. <Col: StageText>Steal a van </Col>- you're going to need space for the safe you'll be stealing next.
stages.dispatch: Lou Konchoda just got out of the state pen after a ten-year stretch. Now looks like his gang is scoping out transport. Get over there and <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>stealing a van</Col>.

stages.owner: Break into this store and <Col: StageText>steal the safe. </Col>Get the van close, because those things are heavy and hard to carry! And if you see any DVDs of 'Pimp My Crib', uh, bring those along too...
stages.dispatch: Lou Konchoda's gang just stole a van, and we suspect they are going to break into a couple of stores. If they follow their usual MO, you'll have to <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>stealing the store safes</Col>.

stages.owner: Nice, the guys are gonna love having some cash to improve the place - I've got a mini-fridge all picked out for our beer. <Col: StageText>Drop the safe </Col>at the hideout; we've got a safe-cracker there who can open it.
stages.dispatch: Too late! The gang made off with some safes. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the safes </Col>to their hideout. Lou Konchoda can crack 'em like walnuts if he gets his hands on them.

stages.owner: Get rid of those hot wheels - don't want that thing tracked back to us. <Col: StageText>Drop the van off.</Col> Then you can pick up the gold lamé wallpaper we ordered...
stages.dispatch: After dropping off those stolen safes, Lou Konchoda's gang is trying to ditch the vehicle used in the robbery so it can't be combed for evidence. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>abandoning the van</Col>.

stages.owner: Shit, you were spotted dumping the van. Create a distraction and <Col: StageText>burn these vehicles</Col>. Don't take long - Pimp My Crib is on in twenty minutes...
stages.dispatch: Lou's gang ditched their van near the freeway construction and are trying to burn other vehicles to disrupt our attempts to capture them. <Col: StageText>Stop the gang </Col>from <Col: StageText>burning the vehicles</Col>.

stages.owner: The safe you stole must've been seriously packed, because the heat is stuck on you. You need something big to get these guys off your back. <Col: StageText>Plant a bomb</Col> here, and <Col: StageText>protect it</Col> till it goes off.
stages.dispatch: The gang is trying to drop off the radar by causing a mass panic with a bombing. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>planting that bomb</Col>.

stages.owner: The local gangs are getting rich by selling off their stolen goods. Now we've discovered who's helping them. Go <Col: StageText>raid the location</Col> of the local fence.
stages.dispatch: We have a guy who moves the goods you acquire for us. The Praetorians are searching his place right now. <Col: StageText>Stop the raid</Col>.

stages.owner: There was no stolen property there. Could have been tipped off, though... <Col: StageText>Pick up</Col> the fence's <Col: StageText>cars</Col> to be impounded.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians found nothing. But they are heading to search the vehicles that belong to our fence. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>picking up the cars</Col>.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Get those cars</Col> back to the Praetorian lockup and we can begin a thorough search for evidence.
stages.dispatch: It will be bad for us if the Praetorians find any of our goods in the fence's vehicles. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering this car</Col> to their vehicle lockup.

stages.owner: A package showed up outside the fence's house. <Col: StageText>Pick up the package</Col> and bring it in. We suspect it's dirty money.
stages.dispatch: Some dickhead just left his payment outside our fence's house. You can't leave it there - or be caught with it. So you better <Col: StageText>stop the Praetorians</Col> from <Col: StageText>recovering that money</Col>.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Deliver that package</Col> back to the Praetorian lockup. It will connect the fence to the car and the stolen goods.
stages.dispatch: That money will link our fence to some of our robberies and get him put away for years. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering the money</Col> to their evidence lockup.

stages.owner: Looks like the fence keeps info on who he works with. We found out where it's stashed, and need you to <Col: StageText>recover it and keep it</Col> away from any criminals.
stages.dispatch: Looks like the fence stashed the info on who he works with. We've found out where it's been stashed and need to <Col: StageText>recover it and keep it</Col> away from any Enforcers.

stages.owner: The Tigers have collected a lot of dirt on a dealer of stolen goods. Now we're ready to take her down. Go <Col: StageText>raid the shop</Col> this fence deals out of.
stages.dispatch: Evita has been selling on the goods you stole for us. Now she may get busted by the Prentiss Tigers. <Col: StageText>Stop their raid</Col> on her shop.

stages.owner: She looks clean, but we know she ain't. While you're in the area, <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>the fence's <Col: StageText>cars</Col> and we can search them for stolen goods.
stages.dispatch: Evita already emptied her shop of our stolen goods, but now the Tigers are going to search her car. They could find evidence of our whole operation. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>picking up her cars</Col>.

stages.owner: Rock on! The Tigers are taking this Criminal fence out of action. <Col: StageText>Deliver those cars</Col> back to our lockup, and we'll strip them for evidence.
stages.dispatch: Evita definitely has some of our stolen goods in those cars. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering the cars </Col>to their vehicle lockup and searching it for evidence.

stages.owner: Ha ha! Someone slipped up and left a packet of money for the fence. <Col: StageText>Pick up the package</Col> and bring it in. That's prime evidence.
stages.dispatch: One of Evita's customers has left his payments for her with a note that mentions us by name. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>recovering that money</Col>.

stages.owner: It's a home run! <Col: StageText>Deliver that package </Col>back to the Tiger lockup. It should link the fence to a whole folder full of unsolved crimes.
stages.dispatch: If the Prentiss Tigers link us to Evita and the stolen goods, we're all going down. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the money</Col> to their evidence lockup.

stages.owner: Looks like the fence keeps info on who she works with. We found out where it's stashed, and need you to <Col: StageText>recover it and keep it</Col> away from any criminals.
stages.dispatch: Evita has been fencing under a different name so Enforcers can't tie the note to her, but they did find out about her stashed book of contacts. <Col: StageText>Recover it and keep it</Col> away from any Enforcers.

stages.owner: Some of the City Council don't like seeing Praetorians on the streets. Prove to them we can tackle the drug problem. <Col: StageText>Raid these drug operations</Col> to demonstrate our effectiveness.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians are trying to look vaguely competent in front of the press by kicking down our doors. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>raiding</Col> our businesses.

stages.owner: They must have been tipped off. The place was empty, aside from some passed-out junkies. New intel points to a second location you need to check out. <Col: StageText>Raid this building</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians are trying to prove to the press how tough they are. Embarrass them. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding</Col> our businesses.

stages.owner: A guy from the first place you busted confessed that there is a stash of drugs in two nearby cars. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the drugs</Col> from the cars.
stages.dispatch: We've loaded up our supplies so the Praetorians won't find them when they raid our properties. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching our cars </Col>until we move out.

stages.owner: Good work. <Col: StageText>Drop off the drugs</Col> at the lockup. Hea Choi says this bust will make us look good at our next press conference.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians have got our car, with our supplies in the trunk. <Col: StageText>Prevent them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering it</Col> back to their lockup.

stages.owner: These Criminals aren't happy about you raiding their drug operation. <Col: StageText>Protect your leader </Col> while trying to <Col: StageText>kill or arrest them</Col>, so they can't re-open for business.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians are going to keep disrupting our operations unless we can stop them, permanently. <Col: StageText>Take out their leader</Col>.

stages.owner: Some of the City Council don't like the whole Prentiss Tiger vibe. <Col: StageText>Raid these drug operations</Col> and show the squares how we play it.
stages.dispatch: The Tigers are out trying to impress their mommies again. Adorable. <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>the brats from <Col: StageText>raiding our business</Col>.

stages.owner: They must've heard we were coming; the place was emptier than the Tiger's chess club. We have a second location. <Col: StageText>Raid the building</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The Tigers are on a PR mission to prove their street smarts - yeah, right! Let's kick their asses while they stand around posing. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding our businesses</Col>.

stages.owner: Pick up those drugs. The rest appear to have been loaded up into vehicles so they can be shipped out. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the drugs </Col>from these two cars.
stages.dispatch: We've loaded up our supplies so the Tigers won't find them during their raids. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching our cars </Col>until we can move 'em out.

stages.owner: Nice job! <Col: StageText>Drop off the drugs</Col> at the lockup. This bust will definitely make us look awesome on the TV. Wave to your mom. I will be.
stages.dispatch: The Tigers got our cars with the supplies in the trunk, the joy-riding bastards. <Col: StageText>Prevent them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering our supplies </Col>back to their frat house.

stages.owner: These Criminals aren't happy about you spoiling their drug party. <Col: StageText>Kill or arrest them</Col> or they'll keep coming back - like herpes. <Col: StageText>Protect your leader </Col>, they'll be gunning for their head.
stages.dispatch: The Tigers are going to keep on pissing in our punchbowl unless we stop them, permanently. <Col: StageText>Take out their leader</Col>!

stages.owner: The San Paro Standard published a story about stores selling DIY plastic surgery kits. Investigate the claims. <Col: StageText>Hack </Col>into this <Col: StageText>network point </Col>and look for abnormal transactions by local stores.
stages.dispatch: Some "brave and courageous" reporters at the Standard ran a story about 'under the counter' DIY plastic surgery kits. Stop the Enforcers <Col: StageText>hacking </Col>into our network to investigate the claims.

stages.owner: Two stores show unusual 'under the counter trading' activity. One of the owners has also been cruising a lot of internet surgery sites. <Col: StageText>Search </Col>these <Col: StageText>locations </Col>for any DIY surgery materials.
stages.dispatch: Enforcers have found information on some of our stores' illegal activities and are headed to search their storage units. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching </Col>the units.

stages.owner: Not the bust we hoped for - The owner's son wants to impress the ladies; hence the web traffic. But you did find stolen car parts. Confiscate the parts and <Col: StageText>drop them off </Col>at this <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The Enforcers searched the storage units. Luckily our DIY surgery stuff ain't stashed there, but they've taken some stolen car parts and are going to <Col: StageText>drop them off </Col>at their lockup. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>.

stages.owner: The techs re-ran that network data you pulled and turned up a hospital orderly. He mentioned a deal with a local store. We have cause to <Col: StageText>raid these storerooms </Col>and look for any medical supplies.
stages.dispatch: Damnit! The Enforcers found out about the main stash of surgical materials. They're on their way to <col: StageText>raid these storerooms</col>. Do whatever you need to do to <Col: StageText>stop them</col>.

stages.owner: That's a hell of a thing: irradiated lipo fat and collagen powder. Wouldn't want that in my ass. This shop is definitely dealing. Pick up that contraband and <Col: StageText>drop it off </Col>at our <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Too late! The Enforcers raided the storerooms and confiscated our DIY surgery materials. They even took the Little Kiki 'My First Botox' kits! <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering </Col>it to their lockup.

Too late! The Enforcers raided the storerooms and confiscated our DIY surgery materials. They even took the Little Kiki 'My First Botox' kits! <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering </Col>it to their lockup and Bring it to ours.

stages.owner: We just got a garbled emergency call - sounded like 'you should pray for the damn paramedics'. Caller was near you. <Col: StageText>Search the nearby ambulance </Col>for anything suspicious.
stages.dispatch: We just sent in a bomb threat to the hospital to act as a decoy. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching this vehicle </Col>and discovering it's a hoax.

stages.owner: Nothing suspicious there, so relocate to where the call was made from and see if anyone is hanging around; <Col: StageText>search the payphone </Col>for intel.
stages.dispatch: 'Torians are scattered around the hospital looking for bombs and generally being distracted, but they could be onto us. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching the payphone </Col>we made the call from.

stages.owner: Nothing there either. Now it sounds more like the anonymous caller said 'pay' rather than 'pray'. <Col: StageText>Search these ATMs</Col> in case. I'll send the audio files off for analysis, or we'll be chasing this all day.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians are closing in on us by tracing the account I used to pay for the hoax phone calls. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching this ATM </Col>and getting fingerprints off of it.

stages.owner: The audio analysis is back. The call was just from some graffiti nuts saying they would 'spray that San Paro relic' rather than 'pray for damn paramedics'. Just go and <Col: StageText>cover up their graffiti tag</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians have finally figured out there were no bombs. But in that time some of our guys had time to put up an awesome new tag. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up this new graffiti</Col>.

stages.owner: We just got a call from the hospital about a threat towards their ambulances. Maybe someone doesn't like the sirens. Get your fat ass over there and <Col: StageText>search their emergency vehicle </Col>for bombs.
stages.dispatch: We need some time to set up the weekly tag competition. My bomb threat to the hospital should keep the Tigers busy. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching this ambulance </Col>and discovering it's all a hoax.

stages.owner: No bombs on the vehicle, but now we got a call about a suspicious <Col: StageText>payphone. </Col>Ya know what that is, right? It's a phone for poor people. Hangs on the wall. Go <Col: StageText>search </Col>it.
stages.dispatch: I've made another hoax call to the Prentiss Tigers, this time about a payphone. Watch them run down there like eager little schoolgirls. Ha ha! <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching the payphone </Col>and spoiling the fun.

stages.owner: The payphone looks clean, as in 'nothing suspicious'. But go wash your hands and rinse away the poverty. On your way, <Col: StageText>search the local ATM </Col>as this is near to where the phone card was purchased.
stages.dispatch: The weekly tag-off graffiti-fest is under way, and we want to keep the Prentiss Tigers as far away as possible. I've told them there is a skimmer on this cash machine. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching the ATM</Col>.

stages.owner: All that running around for nothing; just like gym class. It looks like these calls were a decoy to distract the Tigers while hooligans tagged the area. <Col: StageText>Cover up their graffiti</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Looks like the Tigers finally figured out that it was us making all the hoax calls. But we had enough time to hold the graffiti competition. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up the winner's graffiti</Col>.

stages.owner: Head to this shipping center: we've intercepted communications about explosives being shipped into the city - and without help from the Blood Roses, for once. <Col: StageText>Search this crate </Col>for any contraband.
stages.dispatch: Get over to this shipping center - we had explosives imported into the city but Enforcers are coming to confiscate them. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching this crate</Col>.

stages.owner: Yeah, those explosives are Somatic XAGs; definitely not for demolition work of any legal kind. Confiscate the explosives and <Col: StageText>drop them off </Col>at the <Col: StageText>lockup </Col>facility.
stages.dispatch: Enforcers have confiscated explosives from one of the crates we had shipped into the city. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>dropping off </Col>the explosives at their lockup facility.

stages.owner: Kamotsu Imports shipped the crates you just seized. We checked with them and there were more containers from this shipment sent around the city. <Col: StageText>Check this crate </Col>for any more explosives.
stages.dispatch: One of our shipments has already been seized and Enforcers are going to check our other shipments for explosive devices. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching this crate</Col>.

stages.owner: Whoa! Those are Somatic's highest-grade explosives. Good thing you got to them before they hit the streets. Confiscate them and <Col: StageText>drop them off </Col>at the <Col: StageText>lockup </Col>facility.
stages.dispatch: <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>before they <Col: StageText>drop off </Col>the explosives at their lockup facility. <Col:StageText> Grab the Explosives</Col> and take them to the dead drop.
<Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>before they <Col: StageText>drop off </Col>the explosives at their lockup facility. <Col:StageText> Grab the Explosives</Col> and take them to the dead drop.

stages.owner: A Trexxon exec vanished after it was discovered he was embezzling from the company. Trexxon has asked us to recoup the loss from the employee's assets; start by <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>the <Col: StageText>exec's lockup</Col>.
stages.dispatch: One of our crew - Alonzo - just got busted by the D.A. and the 'Torians are going to confiscate items from his home. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians</Col> from finding anything that will incriminate us.

stages.owner: The exec's cars are nearby; flashy Sungnyemun Moirais. <Col: StageText>Pick up the cars</Col>; they're to be sent back to the company. Take the stuff from the lockup with you.
stages.dispatch: There is information on some of our businesses in Alonzo's cars. Praetorians are heading to impound them. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>the <Col: StageText>cars</Col>.

stages.owner: Before you deliver the cars, <Col: StageText>drop off </Col>the <Col: StageText>exec's assets </Col>from the lockup. Millions of dollars' worth of possessions, in such small boxes; the exec's watch alone probably cost more than my house.
stages.dispatch: Praetorians have raided Alonzo's hideouts and taken his cars for impounding. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the evidence </Col>from the hideouts to the lockup.

stages.owner: I always wanted a car like the Moirai... Though the Praetorians pay well, that car matches Justin Teng's paygrade more than mine. <Col: StageText>Drop off </Col>the <Col: StageText>cars </Col>here.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians haven't realized that the cars they've seized hold important evidence. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the cars </Col>to the impound lot where it'll be thoroughly searched.

stages.owner: The cars contained some evidence of drug use. <Col: StageText>Take </Col>the <Col: StageText>criminal evidence </Col>found in the cars and <Col: StageText>drop it off </Col>at the lockup facility.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians have found some incriminating evidence in Alonzo's confiscated possessions. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the evidence </Col>to the D.A.'s office.

stages.owner: Looks like the ex-exec is still around, and used some of his embezzlement money to hire some muscle. Guess he wants his stuff back. <Col: StageText>Protect your leader</Col> while you <Col: StageText>get rid of these scum.</Col>
stages.dispatch: These Praetorians really think they can stop us by taking down just one member of our crew...? Make them pay for messing with us, <Col: StageText>takeout their leader</Col>.

stages.owner: Just got a call: the Prentiss Rifleman's Club had a break-in and some firearms were stolen. Ballsy stuff. We've promised to get the guns back, so start off by <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>this <Col: StageText>thief's home</Col>.
stages.dispatch: We just ambushed a CUP politician - one of Mayor Derren's party. Left him with nothing but his striped boxers. Now their Enforcers are out to retrieve his things; <Col: StageText>stop them</Col>!

stages.owner: The thief was seen moving rifles to a set of cars nearby: Sungnyemun Moirais. <Col: StageText>Pick up the cars </Col>so we can check them for firearms. Take stuff from the thief's home with you, too.
stages.dispatch: The Enforcers are out to retrieve the politician's stolen Sungnyemun Moirais now. I've grown rather attached to them, though so <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>the <Col: StageText>cars</Col>.

stages.owner: Before you deliver the cars, <Col: StageText>drop off </Col>the <Col: StageText>box of firearms </Col>from the thief's home.
stages.dispatch: As unattractive as it is having the politician we robbed waddle around in his underwear, it's better he stay that way. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the politician's things </Col>to their lockup.

stages.owner: The Moirais you're driving are too expensive for a lowly thief; I'm guessing the Blood Roses had a hand in this. <Col: StageText>Drop off </Col>the <Col: StageText>cars </Col>here and we'll get a forensic team on it.
stages.dispatch: The Enforcers still need to take the politician's shiny Sungnyemun Moirais to safety. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the cars </Col>to the impound lot; I want those Moirais!

stages.owner: The cars contained documents detailing a Blood Rose op: filing the serial numbers off stolen guns and reselling them. <Col: StageText>Take </Col>the <Col: StageText>documents </Col>found in the cars and <Col: StageText>drop them off </Col>at our lockup.
stages.dispatch: Seems the politician had some papers regarding CSA policy in the car. We have friends who could use those... <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>the Enforcers from <Col: StageText>delivering the papers </Col>back to the politician.

stages.owner: The gun thieves look like they want a fight; they're back and armed with Blood Rose weaponry. <Col: StageText>Protect your leader</Col> while you <Col: StageText>get rid of these scum.</Col>
stages.dispatch: The Enforcers have done an annoyingly good job of ruining our fun and making you look bad. If you <Col: StageText>takeout their squad leader</Col> though, I'll forgive you. Maybe.

stages.owner: The CEO of Colby is on a rare visit to San Paro to meet Justin Teng, our leader. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>these known Criminal <Col: StageText>hideouts </Col>along the route he'll take. We don't want any Criminal interference.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians have some sorta big cheese visiting them. Just because we have a few hangouts along his route, they're <Col: StageText>raiding our places</Col>. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>.

stages.owner: Good work, soldier; the last thing we want is a dead billionaire on the streets during our watch. <Col: StageText>Spray over that tag in the area </Col>too, to show we have this location locked down tight.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians don't want their visiting corporate buddies to see any graffiti on the way to their meeting. <Col: StageText>Go stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up our tags</Col>.

stages.owner: A couple of heavily armed thugs have just been spotted on our CCTV. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>their last known <Col: StageText>locations </Col>so I can tell Mr. Teng that the visit can go ahead.
stages.dispatch: Some of our hideouts were raided and our tags covered up by Praetorians - just so they can show off in front of some visiting CEO. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding any more of our hideouts</Col>.

stages.owner: The route has been altered. Our guest, Mr. Colby Jr., will be coming into the City via another route. <Col: StageText>Cover up the tag in that area </Col>too.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians now want to <Col: StageText>cover up more tags </Col>as they'd spoil a big business photo opp. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>. At least we're honest about our activities - unlike these corporate criminals.

stages.owner: The Criminals have found us, despite our detailed preparation. <Col: StageText>Control this area</Col>, give Colby Jr. a show of how we like to use his company's weaponry.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians don't want anything to spoil their high-powered corporate pow-wow. <Col: StageText>Takeover the area</Col> of their meeting to show them how we take care of business.

stages.owner: Pansy-ass elected officials think we're not producing results fast enough. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>these <Col: StageText>drug dens </Col>and show them that Prentiss Tigers have claws.
stages.dispatch: The Pubescent Tigers are trying to drum up political support by smashing up some of our hangouts. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding our places</Col>.

stages.owner: That's an A+ result, duderino; maybe those fat-ass do-nothing politicians will leave us alone a while. <Col: StageText>Spray over the tag in the area</Col> too. Let's make a clean sweep.
stages.dispatch: The Prentiss Tigers who raided our hangouts obviously haven't finished annoying us yet. <Col: StageText>Go stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up our tags</Col> - they are a symbol of our resistance.

stages.owner: The press will love this. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>these other <Col: StageText>drug dens</Col>, while I tell Byeong Lee - he wants to order a press conference. Wipe the blood off your clothes for the cameras... On second thought - don't.
stages.dispatch: Our hideouts have been raided and our tags covered up, just so the Tigers can show off for some politicians. Enough already! <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>any more of our <Col: StageText>hideouts</Col>.

stages.owner: The press conference will be in your area in 15 minutes. Remember, shiny buildings make for good pro-Tigers photos. <Col: StageText>Cover up the tag in this area </Col>too.
stages.dispatch: The Prentiss Tigers want to hold a pro-Enforcer press conference. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up </Col>more of our <Col: StageText>tags</Col>. They say our graffiti spoils their photo opportunity.

stages.owner: A gang of camera-shy Criminals are trying to scare away the press. Losing this photo opportunity could cost us big time - <Col: StageText>control the area</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Let's give the gathered media a real photo opportunity, and something to write about! <Col: StageText>Takeover the area</Col> to show everyone who really runs things around here.

stages.owner: We've got some C.S.I.s in the field in need of supplies; they're busy scraping a prosecutor's brain matter off the walls. <Col: StageText>Pick up the supplies </Col>and get them to the C.S.I. team.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians are trying to dig up some information on a hit our crew did. Go <Col: StageText>prevent them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the supplies </Col>needed for their investigation.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Deliver the supplies </Col>to the C.S.I.s and see if they've found anything. Reports say the murder victim was working on a case against Green Planet; conveniently for them, he's now G-King fodder.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians are <Col: StageText>delivering </Col>forensic supplies to some C.S.I.s they've got in the field investigating our hit. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Pick up the evidence </Col>the C.S.I.s have collected so far, then <Col: StageText>drop it off </Col>at the lockup; they'll pass it on to the lab.
stages.dispatch: Evidence on our crew that carried out the hit has been found by the Praetorians and they're bringing it to their lockup facility. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering that evidence</Col>.

stages.owner: The G-Kings have noticed our investigation; they've sent out some of their gang-bangers to contaminate other crime scenes related to the shooting. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>controlling these areas</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The evidence those Praetorians picked up might lead them to some other crimes we've committed. <Col: StageText>Control and defend these areas </Col>so we can remove any evidence.

stages.owner: A mobster's bloated body turned up just an hour ago. We've got some C.S.I.s in to check it out; they need special gear. <Col: StageText>Pick up the supplies </Col>and get it out to them.
stages.dispatch: The Tigers are trying to investigate a mobster corpse we'd prefer stay dead and buried. Go <Col: StageText>prevent them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the materials </Col>needed for their investigation.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Deliver the supplies </Col>to the C.S.I.s and <Col: StageText>pick up the evidence </Col>they've collected so far. The corpse had info about some 'Sal Murino' guy, I hear. Maybe it's the reason he got whacked?
stages.dispatch: The Tigers are <Col: StageText>delivering </Col>forensic supplies to C.S.I.s investigating the dead mobster we put in the ground. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>.

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Pick up the evidence </Col>the C.S.I.s have gathered and <Col: StageText>deliver </Col>it to our <Col: StageText>lockup </Col>. I don't think we'll find this Sal guy, though; he disappeared from Witness Protection years ago.
stages.dispatch: The Tigers found evidence on that mobster's corpse that links him to the crew we got to whack him. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering that evidence</Col> to their lockup facility.

stages.owner: A few of the Mob seem to think we capped the dead mobster. They're heading out to rough up some of our people. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>controlling these areas.</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The evidence those Tigers picked up might lead them to some other crimes we've committed. <Col: StageText>Control and defend these areas </Col>so we can remove any evidence.

stages.owner: OCA reported a shipment of prototype <Col: StageText>HPM Devices </Col>missing; we're talking serious EMP weaponry here. We traced the prototypes to this location; <Col: StageText>retrieve </Col>the devices from these <Col: StageText>vehicles</Col>. ASAP.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians are trying to <Col: StageText>recover </Col>a shipment of <Col: StageText>EMP weaponry </Col>we hijacked. Use your more conventional weapons to <Col: StageText>stop them</Col>.

stages.owner: We've found a few more of the missing <Col: StageText>HPM Devices </Col>in these <Col: StageText>vehicles</Col>. Go <Col: StageText>retrieve them </Col>and make sure you don't set any off; they fire beams that fry the electronics in everything they touch.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians have already recovered half of the arms shipment we lifted, <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the rest of the EMP weapons</Col>.

stages.owner: Nice work! <Col: StageText>Drop off </Col>the <Col: StageText>HPM Devices </Col>at our lockup. I'm glad we found them; in the wrong hands they could decimate security systems, kill vehicles or fry comms in mere seconds.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians have the last of the <Col: StageText>EMP weaponry</Col>. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering </Col>the shipment back to their lockup.

stages.owner: We've got the HPM Devices secured, but it doesn't look we're out of the woods yet; the outfit that stole them are looking for their stolen goods. <Col: StageText>Protect your leader.</Col>
stages.dispatch: These Praetorians think they can just take our weaponry? <Col: StageText>Take out their leader </Col>to show them who really runs things around here.

stages.owner: I don't know if you've met Nora or not - a fellow Tiger. She lent us some <Col: StageText>surveillance equipment </Col>from her father's stores, but now it's been stolen. Go <Col: StageText>retrieve it </Col>from these <Col: StageText>vehicles</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The Prentiss Tigers are trying to retrieve some surveillance equipment we stole. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding our car</Col>.

stages.owner: There's more <Col: StageText>surveillance equipment </Col>in these <Col: StageText>vehicles</Col>. Go <Col: StageText>retrieve it</Col>. If Nora knew it had been stolen, she'd be out with her minigun! Interesting to watch, but the collateral damage...
stages.dispatch: The Tigers are after the remaining stolen <Col: StageText>surveillance equipment</Col>. <Col: StageText>Protect </Col>the <Col: StageText>van </Col>we're using to move the equipment; last thing we need is their dirty paw-marks all over it.

stages.owner: Good Job! <Col: StageText>Drop off </Col>Nora's <Col: StageText>surveillance equipment </Col>at our lockup. It's a good thing she's visiting Fourche Bank right now; this way she doesn't even have to know it's gone missing.
stages.dispatch: The Tigers are running off with the stolen <Col: StageText>surveillance equipment </Col>The nerve! <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from getting the equipment to their <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.

stages.owner: We've tracked down the Blood Roses who managed to steal Nora's surveillance equipment. We might have the equipment back, but they'll be coming for payback. <Col: StageText>Protect your leader.</Col>
stages.dispatch: The Tigers got the stolen equipment and messed up two of our vans; we can't stand for that! <Col: StageText>Take out their leader</Col>. It'll go some way towards making up for them screwing us over.

stages.owner: We just got an unusual call from an undercover cop - Officer Albert Finn of the SPPD. He's hidden a PDA with details about an urgent mission. Go <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>the <Col: StageText>PDA</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The Enforcers are using this area as a dead drop for their undercover operatives. Make the area too dangerous for them and <Col: StageText>interrupt any pick-ups </Col>they attempt.

stages.owner: Officer Finn is working deep, deep, deep undercover. Several SPPD officers just turned up to a drug deal with his gang. He left us information on who: <Col: StageText>search these vehicles </Col>for his <Col: StageText>files</col>.
stages.dispatch: Looks like we've got a mole - that PDA was dropped off by somebody in our gang. Now the Enforcers are after files incriminating some of our members. <Col: StageText>Stop the pick-up</Col>.

stages.owner: Officer Finn left another set of <Col: StageText>files </Col>for <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>at these addresses, <Col: StageText>raid them</Col>. With corrupt SPPD officers involved, Officer Finn knows its only us he can trust. Don't let him down.
stages.dispatch: That undercover mole has been busy - the Enforcers are picking up more information on our gang operations. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>recovering those files</Col>.

stages.owner: You've got all the files. <Col: StageText>Deliver everything </Col>here and we'll start moving in on the suspects. Watch out for reprisals - corrupt cops have a lotta dangerous friends.
stages.dispatch: If we ever want to find out who our Enforcer mole is, we need to recover that information. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the files </Col>to their lockup.

stages.owner: As a clincher, Officer Finn wants us to <Col: StageText>retrieve and hold </Col>onto his <Col: StageText>laptop </Col>until we download all the corroborating data.
stages.dispatch: This is getting out of hand - now the mole has taken a laptop detailing our latest plans. <Col: StageText>Retrieve and hold </Col>onto our <Col: StageText>laptop </Col>until we can delete all the data.

stages.owner: We've got some Pit Vipers in the lockup and we need you to <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>their street racing <Col: StageText>cars </Col>and <Col: StageText>deliver them </Col>to the impound lot.
stages.dispatch: <Col: StageText>Stop Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>our street racing <Col: StageText>cars </Col>and <Col: StageText>impounding </Col>them. At this point in the season, we'd miss the Silver Street leg of the race for sure. ↵

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Drop off </Col>those Pit Viper <Col: StageText>cars </Col>at the <Col: StageText>impound lot</Col>. If we don't keep bustin' their shit, they'll just keep riding all over us.
stages.dispatch: Enforcers picked up three of our street racing <Col: StageText>cars </Col>- <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>dropping </Col>them back to their <Col: StageText>impound </Col>lot. I still can't see what their beef is with street racing through pedestrian areas!

stages.owner: Nice work, we just picked up more racers - White Blades this time. They hate the Pit Vipers, so we're gonna throw 'em in a cell together. <Col: StageText>Pick up their cars </Col>.
stages.dispatch: Enforcers are trying to impound more of our street racing cars. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the cars</Col>. Don't they know we're three wins away from a championship placing?

stages.owner: <Col: StageText>Drop off </Col>those White Blade cars <Col: StageText>here </Col>and we'll lock them up. You should hear the ruckus down in the cell block. Blades hate Vipers, that's a fact.
stages.dispatch: We need those street racing <Col: StageText>cars </Col>- <Col: StageText>stop </Col>the Enforcers <Col: StageText>dropping them off </Col>at their <Col: StageText>impound </Col>lot. We're already behind after forfeiting the Silver Street leg of the race.

stages.owner: Looks like our luck could be back in - we just located a garbage truck containing evidence from some White Blades that got busted.<Col:StageText> Grab that truck</Col> and <Col:StageText>Protect it</Col> until we can get a confession.
stages.dispatch: There's a garbage truck out there containing proof we've been using illegal mods.  If the other racers find out we'll be out for sure.  <Col:StageText> Capture and Hold the Dumpster</Col> while the crusher does its work.

stages.owner: Bomb threats have been made against some local <Col: StageText>drugstores </Col>that have been selling an anti-gang pepper spray called 'Gangrenous'. <Col: StageText>Investigate </Col>the targets thoroughly.
stages.dispatch: Stores have been colluding with drug companies to screw customers into buying expensive medicine. We've planted bombs in front of two drugstores. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>finding </Col>them.

stages.owner: These bombs are well-hidden: they're actually fitted under the sidewalk slabs! <Col: StageText>Defuse the bombs </Col>and let these drugstores continue stocking the pro-'Forcer pepper spray.
stages.dispatch: Enforcers found the bombs we planted in front of those corrupt drugstores. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>defusing </Col>the bombs. The 'Forcers are helping to prop up these corrupt pharmaceutical companies.

stages.owner: Makers of the 'Gangrenous' pepper spray are going to be holding a large publicity event soon. Get over there and <Col: StageText>investigate the area </Col>for possible sabotage before they set up.
stages.dispatch: We've already planted some hidden bombs near the HQs of the drug companies. <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>the corporate puppet <Col: StageText>Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching </Col>for the <Col: StageText>bombs</Col>.

stages.owner: It's another one of those slim-line IEDs. <Col: StageText>Defuse the bomb</Col>. Pick it up when it's been made safe; obviously, we need to gain a better understanding of this dangerous new device.
stages.dispatch: A bomb we planted outside the corrupt pharmaceutical company has been found by Enforcers. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>defusing </Col>the bomb and examining it for clues.

stages.owner: We're closing in on the gang responsible for this new bomb design. Meanwhile, <Col: StageText>search the area </Col>where 'Gangrenous' are going to be holding product demonstrations. Hidden bombs could be there too.
stages.dispatch: To distract Enforcers from investigating the previous bombing, we planted another IED. They're in such a panic their whole investigation into our bombs might unravel - or so we hope. <Col: StageText>Stop them searching for the bomb</Col>.

stages.owner: These bombs are almost invisible. I wonder how they get the profile so thin. <Col: StageText>Defuse the bomb </Col>and keep it safe. We need to get a closer look.
stages.dispatch: One of our guys has been getting sloppy with the bomb-planting and forgot to wear gloves. <Col: StageText>Stop this squad </Col>from <Col: StageText>defusing </Col>the bomb and recovering it for fingerprints.

stages.owner: Now <Col: StageText>drop off </Col>the defused <Col: StageText>bombs </Col>you've found to the nearby <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>. We'll examine them carefully and find out what makes them tick.
stages.dispatch: Enough of our bombs have been recovered for the Enforcers to be able to trace them back to us. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>dropping off </Col>our bombs to their forensics <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.

stages.owner: The gang want to set off another of their stealth bombs near the location of a big 'Gangrenous' pepper spray publicity shindig. <Col: StageText>Prevent </Col>the <Col: StageText>bombing </Col>.
stages.dispatch: I'm sick of these Enforcers propping up corrupt drug companies. <Col: StageText>Defend the bomb </Col>I planted in this public area to highlight their ruthless disregard for people's health.

stages.owner: Praetorian high command needs some quick wins for our anti-drug campaign. <Col: StageText>Search this neighborhood. </Col>The stats show a high level of drug dealing in the area.
stages.dispatch: These street corners belong to some drug dealing friends of ours who pay us to provide security. They've recently seen the Praetorians patrolling. <Col: StageText>Keep the Praetorians out</Col>.

stages.owner: The campaign is working. An informant saw your patrol and has given us the location of a drug stash. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the drugs</Col>.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians have found out about the local drug drop-off point and have been searching for it. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up</Col> anything our dealer friends have stashed.

stages.owner: Better move quick: those dealers have another distribution point. <Col: StageText>Retrieve </Col>their secondary stash of <Col: StageText>drugs</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Tragic! The Praetorians found the drug drop-off point and confiscated the stash. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from  <Col: StageText>seizing </Col>any more or we could lose the dealers as clients.

stages.owner: Clean work out there. Now <Col: StageText>transfer the drugs </Col>to our facility.
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians have searched all the drop-off points in this area and seized the drugs. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering </Col>it to their <Col: StageText>lockup.</Col>

stages.owner: The anti-drug campaign is working. <Col: StageText>Protect your leader </Col> some dealers are looking to show how pissed off they are!
stages.dispatch: The Praetorians seized our client's goods. They are not happy. Make sure the Praetorians can never do this again. <Col: StageText>Take out their leader.</Col>

stages.owner: Byeong Lee wants us to <Col: StageText>go</Col> and to make our presence felt. This <Col: StageText>neighborhood</Col> is making a ton of complaints that drug dealing is going down.
stages.dispatch: These street corners belong to some drug dealing friends of ours who pay us to provide security. We hear the Prentiss Tigers have suddenly got heavy in this neighborhood. <Col: StageText>Keep them out</Col> by making it too dangerous for them to stick around.

stages.owner: Byeong was right. Some dudes saw you around and tipped us off where a drop point is. Get out there and <Col: StageText>snatch the drugs</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Those Prentiss frat boys found out about the local drug drop-off points and have been searching them. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up</Col> the stash.

stages.owner: This reminds me of what Coach Patchings used to say about locker searches: find one stash and it points to the next one. Go and <Col: StageText>retrieve the drugs</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Are the Tigers planning a party? They've got half of the drug supply for this area already! <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>any more of our client's product.

stages.owner: Time for a race to the end zone: <Col: StageText>drop off the drugs </Col>at our lockup.
stages.dispatch: It's not too late to recover our reputation with the client. I know where the Tigers' local lockup is. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the drugs </Col>and we are back in favor.

stages.owner: All right! Seems like the dirty dealers want to make a fight out of it. Suits me. <Col: StageText>Protect your leader </Col> and <Col: StageText>arrest them or take them out.</Col> Game on!
stages.dispatch: We've got one last chance to resolve this matter for our clients and eliminate the problem at source. <Col: StageText>Take their leader out.</Col>

stages.owner: Thieves robbed a bank that was under Praetorian protection. They were seen escaping into this neighborhood. <Col: StageText>Check this building </Col>for any sign of the perpetrators.
stages.dispatch: Some of our guys robbed a bank and are hiding out in this neighborhood. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching </Col>the area.

stages.owner: That address wasn't occupied, but a neighbor reported armed men abandoning gear and equipment before entering another building. <Col: StageText>Raid the building </Col>before their backup arrives.
stages.dispatch: The 'Forcers have found the location of our bank robbery squad. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>their location.

stages.owner: The thieves fled, but we found personal effects that will help us track them down. <Col: StageText>Pick up the evidence </Col>and <Col: StageText>drop it off </Col>at our <Col: StageText>lockup.</Col>
stages.dispatch: Thankfully our robbery team made a quick exit, but the Praetorians now have some abandoned tools and clothing that may lead to their capture. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the evidence </Col>to their <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.

stages.owner: The Criminals are in the open and on the run. They've dropped <Col: StageText>cash </Col>whilst being pursued. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the cash </Col>before they do!
stages.dispatch: That escape didn't go quite as planned. Our team were forced to drop some bags of cash while being pursued. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the cash </Col>before the Praetorians can use it to build a case.

stages.owner: The Criminals are in the open and on the run. They've dropped <Col: StageText>cash </Col>whilst being pursued. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the cash </Col>before they do!
stages.dispatch: That escape didn't go quite as planned. Our team were forced to drop some bags of cash while being pursued. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the cash </Col>before the Praetorians can use it to build a case.

stages.owner: All the discarded money from the robbery has been picked up. <Col: StageText>Drop off the cash </Col>at the Praetorian lockup ASAP. Don't let the Criminals get hold of it!

stages.dispatch: All the cash dropped from the robbery has been picked up. <Col: StageText>Take the cash </Col>to our hideout, and don't let the Praetorians recover it. It is damning evidence against us - as well as our bonus!

stages.owner: Thieves from a recent bank robbery have been seen fleeing into this neighborhood. It's Tiger time! Go <Col: StageText>check out these buildings </Col>for any clues.
stages.dispatch: Some of our guys robbed a bank recently and are hiding out in this neighborhood. <Col: StageText>Stop the Prentiss Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching </Col>the area.

stages.owner: We got some partial prints and an address where the robbers may be hiding out. <Col: StageText>Raid the building.</Col>
stages.dispatch: Damn! The Prentiss killjoys have found where we concealed the bank robbers. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>their refuge.

stages.owner: The robbers must have been tipped off. But they abandoned some specialist equipment that should help us hunt them down. <Col: StageText>Pick up the evidence </Col>and <Col: StageText>drop it off </Col>at our <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Our guys escaped, but they left some specialist kit behind that connects them to the robbery. <Col: StageText>Stop the Prentiss Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the evidence </Col>to their <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.

stages.owner: The bank robbers are feeling the power of the Tigers. They fled like rabbits and dropped some bags of money. Go <Col: StageText>get the cash </Col>before the criminals grow a pair and get their grubby hands on it.
stages.dispatch: What is it? Amateur hour around here? Our guys dropped some of the stolen cash as they made a tactical retreat. <Col: StageText>Go get the cash </Col>before the Tigers get their claws into it.

stages.owner: The bank robbers are feeling the power of the Tigers. They fled like rabbits and dropped some bags of money. Go <Col: StageText>get the cash </Col>before the criminals grow a pair and get their grubby hands on it.
stages.dispatch: What is it? Amateur hour around here? Our guys dropped some of the stolen cash as they made a tactical retreat. <Col: StageText>Go get the cash </Col>before the Tigers get their claws into it.

stages.owner: All the cash dropped from the robbery has been picked up. <Col: StageText>Get the cash</Col> to the local Prentiss Tiger  lockup, and don't let the Criminals get in your way!

stages.dispatch: All the cash dropped from the robbery has been reclaimed. You might just save the day. <Col: StageText>Get the cash </Col>to our hideout, and don't embarrass yourself by letting the Tigers get it back to their stinking lair.

stages.owner: An SPPD Narcotics officer has gone missing while deep undercover. We agreed to look into it. <Col: StageText>Hack this antenna </Col>so we can track the officer's cell phone.
stages.dispatch: An undercover cop infiltrated our operation - find him before the SPPD uses Enforcers to extract him. <Col: StageText>Stop Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>hacking this aerial </Col>in order to track the informant's cell phone.

stages.owner: We're not getting any signal from that Narcotics officer's phone. It may just be out of range. <Col: StageText>Bug this satellite dish </Col>to search a larger range.
stages.dispatch: They're still trying to extract that undercover SPPD cop. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>rigging this satellite </Col>to boost the range of their cell phone scan. They're using it to search for him.

stages.owner: Still no signal, so either the cell phone is turned off or he left the city. We do have the last known position of the cell signal, though. <Col: StageText>Raid this building </Col>- and keep a sharp eye out for any signs of trouble.
stages.dispatch: We've dealt with the cop who infiltrated our operation, but now Enforcers are searching for him at his last phoned-in location. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding this smuggling office</Col>.

stages.owner: The officer wasn't there, but something obviously went down. Looks like a drug deal gone bad... Whoa, hold on: the officer's cell was just turned on, and we've located it. <Col: StageText>Raid this location</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Enforcers are still searching for information on the SPPD cop we 'took care of'. Don't let them search this building until we've cleaned it up. <Col: StageText>Stop Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding this storehouse</Col>.

stages.owner: The evidence suggests that the Narcotics officer was brought here and killed. He must've turned his phone on while they were moving him. <Col: StageText>Deliver </Col>any <Col: StageText>clues </Col>you've found to our <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Enforcers have found evidence for what we did to that SPPD officer. Wasn't hard - the crime scene wasn't too pretty... <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the evidence </Col>to their lockup.

stages.owner: We've received enough evidence that a warrant is out on the criminals involved.  <Col:StageText> Take them down</Col>, dead or alive.
stages.dispatch: The Enforcers recovered evidence on the killing of that SPPD officer, we're going to go down for life. <Col: StageText>Kill the Assholes </Col>before they can testify.

stages.owner: Due to the sensitive nature of this task, your briefing will be given in the field. Move out and <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>the <Col: StageText>encrypted PDA</Col>.
stages.dispatch: Enforcers are picking up an encrypted PDA that contains orders for their next covert mission. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the PDA </Col>and we can stop their mission before it starts.

stages.owner: A deep cover informant within the Blood Roses has compiled detailed files on several key figures. <Col: StageText>Search for </Col>the <Col: StageText>files </Col>left in these <Col: StageText>cars</Col>.
stages.dispatch: As part of 'Operation Killjoy', the Enforcer's are planning to eliminate gang leaders. Their first objective is to retrieve various case files. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers searching the cars for files</Col>.

stages.owner: Another set of <Col: StageText>files </Col>have been left for <Col: StageText>retrieval </Col>; raid this <Col: StageText>address</Col> to get at them. The longer these files are left out, the more chance there is of them falling into the wrong hands.
stages.dispatch: That covert team is picking up a sniper rifle and various targets' bios. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>retrieving the assassination kit</Col>.

stages.owner: You've gathered all the files left by our Blood Rose informant. <Col: StageText>Drop everything off </Col>here. Make sure you're not followed.
stages.dispatch: <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>the Enforcers from <Col: StageText>getting </Col>the <Col: StageText>assassination kit </Col>back <Col: StageText>to their lockup</Col>. That rifle and target information could be used to take out some of our high-ranking members.

stages.owner: You've gathered enough evidence to put away quite a few Blood Rose gang members. <Col: StageText>Protect </Col>your squad <Col: StageText>leader </Col>until you can <Col: StageText>kill off the enemies </Col>out to silence you.
stages.dispatch: We lost track of the assassination kit, but we can still <Col: StageText>take out </Col>the Enforcer <Col: StageText>group leader </Col>- that's the government spook who's going to pull the trigger for those assassinations.

stages.owner: The SPPD just handed us a cold case from a few years back. <Col: StageText>Take </Col>these <Col: StageText>files </Col>and go over them at the crime scene. The victim was an SPPD cop, back in the time of Commissioner Thirly.
stages.dispatch: A buddy of ours got away with murder a long time ago, but it looks like the Enforcers are re-opening his cold case. <Col: StageText>Prevent Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>any new <Col: StageText>evidence</Col>.

stages.owner: New witnesses say they saw the cop in two other locations the night he was killed. <Col: StageText>Go to the crime scenes</Col>, and update the case files with any new evidence you find.
stages.dispatch: Where the gun was stashed and the body turned up were key locations in that cold homicide case. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>investigating </Col>those <Col: StageText>crime scenes</Col>. Unless someone's built a mall on them...

stages.owner: Great work - looks like that SPPD cop was murdered by a colleague. Tsk tsk... <Col: StageText>Deliver </Col>the <Col: StageText>updated files </Col>back <Col: StageText>to the lockup </Col>for analysis.
stages.dispatch: The 'Forcers have just finished going over those crime scenes and updated a bunch of cold case files. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>dropping off </Col>the <Col: StageText>files </Col>for analysis.

stages.owner: That cop-killing cop has hired help to screw up the last of the evidence. <Col: StageText>Secure these crime scenes</Col>: if we can uncover solid DNA evidence, we’ll be able run it against the SPPD databases to find our killer.
stages.dispatch: Our homicidal friend is leaving town, but he told us where the 'Forcers will head next. <Col: StageText>Go to these crime scenes</Col> and contaminate them. Ruin the evidence so it will be inadmissable in court.

stages.owner: A Blood Rose is blogging about a new shipment of grenades. They were sent as components to stay undetected, but we found them. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the grenade body assemblies </Col>from this <Col: StageText>vehicle</Col>.
stages.dispatch: We had a shipment of grenades sent as separate components but the Enforcers still found them! <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>the 'Forcers from <Col: StageText>retrieving the box </Col>of grenade casings we hid in this <Col: StageText>vehicle</Col>.
